product_name: Qualcomm Snapdragon SPU (Secure Processing Unit), part of the Snapdragon 845 Mobile Platform
product_brief: A self-contained hardware Secure Processing Unit in the Snapdragon 845 that generates and manages cryptographic keys in a vault-like environment.
key_management_model: Hardware key storage in a self-contained SPU with its own key management facility; generates and uses unique cryptographic digital keys to encrypt user files; keys stored and managed by the SPU are segregated from the main CPU.
architecture_type: On-die secure processing unit within the Snapdragon mobile processor, with its own power grid, dedicated CPU, RAM, crypto-engines, and key management facility; boots independently.
primary_platforms: Mobile devices (smartphones) powered by the Snapdragon 845 Mobile Platform
target_industries: Mobile devices / consumer smartphones; mobile payments; device makers

evidence.Latest Version: A new layer of hardware security — the Secure Processing Unit (SPU) — is added to the Snapdragon 845 mobile platform

product_brief: STMicroelectronics composite TOE: NesLib 6.11.3 cryptographic library on ST31R480 A02 Security IC, Common Criteria EAL5+ certified.
pqc_support: Yes — LMS stateful hash-based signature (verification) in NesLib
pqc_capability_description: NesLib includes a module supporting the "(post-quantum) stateful hash-based LMS signature scheme"; TSS lists "LMS signature verification (FCS_COP.1) / SFH-DSA". No other PQC algorithms (ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, etc.) are mentioned in the provided text.
crypto_primitives: DES, Triple DES, AES, SHA-1, SHA-2, SHA-3, Keccak, Keccak-p, RSA, Diffie-Hellman, ECC (short Weierstrass), ECDH, ECDSA, Ed25519, Ed448, X25519, X448, LMS, DRBG
architecture_type: Smartcard/secure element Security IC (ST31R480 A02) with embedded cryptographic software library (NesLib) delivered as a binary linked into the Embedded Software; uses platform AES, triple DES accelerators and Nescrypt crypto accelerator
primary_platforms: ST31R480 A02 Security IC (wafers, micromodules or packages); applications such as pay-TV, banking cards, SIM cards, health cards, transportation cards, identity and passport cards
target_industries: Payment/banking, telecom (SIM), pay-TV, brand protection, healthcare, transportation, access management, identity/passport (government)
regulatory_status: Common Criteria evaluated and certified under EUCC (certificate EUCC-3090-2026-56) with the French NCCA; EAL5 augmented by ALC_DVS.2, AVA_VAN.5, ALC_FLR.2 and COMP; strict conformance to BSI-CC-PP-0084-2014
signature_schemes: ECDSA (generation and verification), Ed25519, Ed448, RSA, LMS (verification, stateful hash-based)
implementation_attack_surface: The TOE addresses threats in the Platform Security Target including inherent and forced information leakage, physical probing, physical manipulation, malfunction due to environmental stress, abuse of functionality; limited fault tolerance (FRU_FLT.2) and failure with preservation of secure state (FPT_FLS.1) are listed.
testing_&_validation_methods: Common Criteria EAL5+ evaluation (AVA_VAN.5 vulnerability analysis, ATE_COV, ATE_FUN); no KAT/ACVP/CAVP information in the provided text.

constrained_device_&_iot_suitability: Designed for Security ICs/smartcards (ST31R480 secure element); library stored in User NVM and linked into embedded application code.
supply_chain_&_vendor_risk: Proprietary library developed by STMicroelectronics (Connected Security division); delivered as encrypted, signed binary via email or secure file transfer; development and production sites listed; no SBOM/CBOM stated.
deployment_&_migration_complexity: ES developer must link the NesLib binary into applicative code; no migration phases or rollback procedures stated.
